— Tracking & performance —

Which version gets agents asking for more?

Every query with a version counts here, from the first one you sent.

Start tracking versions

i

When you save your first version, we’ll assume they went out with your original manuscript and count them there. If any went out differently, it’s easy to change.

  1. 1

    Save the manuscript as it stands.

    Your first version is the book you’re sending now. Give it a name you’ll recognise.

    e.g. Prologue first
  2. 2

    Save a new version when the opening changes.

    List what you changed, one thing at a time. We’ll draw how each version leads to the next.

    e.g. Fast-paced opening · Cut the prologue · Opens on the ferry
  3. 3

    Each query records the version that went.

    Over time you’ll see which opening gets agents asking for more.

    e.g. 40% asked for more, from 5 queries

A version is the same story told a different way. A new book is a new manuscript.
